newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up, front month driven by output worries.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up, front month driven by output worries.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures ticked up higher on Wednesday morning, with the front month seeing most activity following concerns over short- term production problems.

The physical market on Tuesday had seen day-ahead activity at higher prices as rumours of production problems at Bacton led some players to look for prompt gas. A futures broker said that these concerns had been the main driver behind price movements on futures in the morning session.
Front month May opened at 10.30 and traded 55 lots in four trades, rising to 10.40 by the end of the morning session. It had previously settled at 10.295 on Tuesday evening.
Otherwise activity was muted with single trades done in July, August and January for 10 lots each. January posted the biggest gain, up by 0.15 pence a therm to 16.75.
